Wei Qiang used to have 5 pen pals. He is no longer pen pals with 2 of them. Each of them sends 2 letters of 5 pages each per week. He responds in the same way. He can write one page in 6 minutes. How many hours does he spend writing letters per week?

First, we need to find out how many pen pals Wei Qiang currently has. He started with 5 and lost contact with 2, so he has 5 - 2 = 3 pen pals.

Next, we need to calculate the total number of letters he receives per week. Each of his 3 pen pals sends 2 letters per week, so he receives 3 * 2 = 6 letters per week.

Since he responds to each letter he receives, he also sends 6 letters per week.

Each letter has 5 pages, so he writes a total of 6 * 5 = 30 pages per week.

He can write one page in 6 minutes, so he spends 30 * 6 = 180 minutes writing letters per week.

Finally, we need to convert the time from minutes to hours. There are 60 minutes in an hour, so he spends 180 / 60 = 3 hours writing letters per week.

3
